title: Two women we remember with love
intro: Today we remember two women, one from Lombardy and one from Sicily. We share only what trusted sources have told us, and we hold them in our thoughts with gratitude.

women.name: Tatiana Vasilica Marcu
tribute: Tatiana Vasilica Marcu was 46 years old and lived in Viganò, in the province of Lecco. She is in our thoughts.

women.name: A woman from Capo d'Orlando
tribute: She was 55 years old and lived in Capo d'Orlando, in the province of Messina. She is in our thoughts.
